task_criteria: install.sh --rule-pack <name> only accepts packs shipped in plugin/terminal_jail/rules/packs/. Add a new flag --rule-pack-file <path> that: (1) validates the pack with rule-pack-tool.py validate <path>, (2) byte-copies it to the resolved rules dir (same destination as --rule-pack), (3) adds a symmetric --uninstall-rule-pack-file <path> that removes the installed copy. Document both flags in README.md under the rule-pack section. Add a test in scripts/test_install.sh (or extend the existing install test) that creates a temp pack file, installs it with --rule-pack-file, verifies it landed in the rules dir, then uninstalls it. Run the test and confirm it passes.
